description: This is a C++ source file implementing a DeviceInfo plugin component for a larger software system. It provides methods for retrieving device information such as system info, addresses, socket info, firmware version, serial number, model id, make, model name, device type, distributor id, supported ports, and resolution details via registered properties and endpoints.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Implements device information retrieval for a plugin system, including registration, unregistration, and property endpoint methods.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers device information properties and endpoints to the plugin system.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all device information properties and endpoints from the plugin system.

methods.name: get_modelid
methods.description: Retrieves device model ID or SKU.

methods.name: endpoint_defaultresolution
methods.description: Retrieves default resolution for a specified video display port.

methods.name: endpoint_supportedresolutions
methods.description: Retrieves supported resolutions for a specified video display port.

methods.name: endpoint_supportedhdcp
methods.description: Retrieves supported HDCP version for a specified video display port.

methods.name: endpoint_audiocapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves audio capabilities for a specified audio port.

methods.name: endpoint_ms12capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves MS12 audio capabilities for a specified audio port.

methods.name: endpoint_supportedms12audioprofiles
methods.description: Retrieves supported MS12 audio profiles for a specified audio port.
